how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-moonglade-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1124:obj:0: Speak with Layo Starstrike near the Valor's Rest graveyard of ⟦E1⟧, showing him Rabine's Letter.
rows.quest:1124:details:0: West of ⟦E2⟧, via the northwestern ridge, is a harsh wasteland - ⟦E1⟧. Few know that an ancient war was waged there between the night elves and a malign, alien power. The evil was sealed, but now we suspect that forces work to stir this... unspeakable horror.
rows.quest:1124:details:1: BSeek out Layo Starstrike, one of our agents in ⟦E1⟧; look for him at Valor's Rest, the final resting spot for the fallen of the wastes. Give him this letter, and he will give you his trust accordingly.
rows.quest:1124:completion:0: Rabine sent you, did he? Well, consider yourself welcomed here... as much as this desolate and forsaken land can welcome someone.
rows.quest:1124:completion:1: BI wasn't alive during the time of the great tribulations that took place here, but there are parts of this desert that might as well be eerie pictures of that forgotten past. With your help, the Cenarion Circle might be able to bring finality to a threat that was supposed to have died generations ago.
rows.quest:1185:completion:0: Hey, it's you again! Well, I mean you - as in the you that is ⟦1⟧! Yes - that you!
rows.quest:1185:completion:2: BThat object you found in ⟦E1⟧ - it was in fact a book. It was a journal written in a very ancient dialect of what we now call the Darnassian tongue. It'll take a while, but I'm going to go over it very thoroughly. I thought you should know that what you found was extremely valuable for the Circle.
rows.quest:1185:completion:3: BThe den mother's all excited and everything!
rows.quest:5526:obj:0: Find the Felvine in Dire ⟦E3⟧ and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:5526:details:0: Your knowledge of Eldre'Thalas - Dire ⟦E3⟧ - in ⟦E5⟧ will now come into play, ⟦2⟧. In the eastern part of the ruined city is where Alzzin the Wildshaper has exerted his corrupt dominion. Go there with all due haste and brave whatever challenges await you.
rows.quest:5526:details:1: BThe Fruit of Fertility, now corrupted as the Felvine, should be close to Alzzin. When he falls, capture whatever essence of the Felvine you can. Seal it in the Reliquary, and bring it to me.
rows.quest:5526:completion:0: It is done, brave ⟦3⟧, and with that the Cenarion Circle is in your debt. Though the war is far from over, a great battle has been won against those who would bring about our doom.
rows.quest:5526:completion:1: BPlease - accept this as a token of our enduring gratitude. Know that you are welcomed here as a hero of the Cenarion Circle for your great deed, ⟦4⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:5527:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E1⟧ and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:5527:details:0: The first step is to find a container capable of holding an extremely corruptible substance without the handler suffering ill effects. There is only one sort device I am aware of that could possibly contain something as vile as the Felvine: a Reliquary of Purity.
rows.quest:5527:details:1: BDeep in the wasteland of ⟦E1⟧ is the remnants of the night elf village known as Southwind. I know one was there many, many years ago. If we are to succeed, I need you to scour those ruins in the hopes of reclaiming it.
rows.quest:5527:completion:0: Indeed, you are as resourceful as many claim. The Cenarion Circle is blessed to have you working in our stead.
rows.quest:5527:completion:1: BWith the Reliquary once more in our hands, my mind is at ease. I feel more comfortable asking you to not only face down a malfeasant demon, but also to bring back a dangerous item in the process...
rows.quest:6845:obj:0: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:6845:details:0: Anyway, you should check back with me relatively soon... that is if you want to know what was in here. As soon as I find out what it is, and if it's indeed a book, I'd be happy to share that information with you.
rows.quest:6845:details:1: BIn the meantime, I'd check in with the den mother of this little bear camp, Rabine. No doubt he'll want to know what crazy antics you've been up to. Never leave the den mother waiting, ⟦5⟧... that is, unless you want to be doused in honey.
rows.quest:6845:completion:0: Ah, ⟦6⟧ - I had hoped you would stop by. I am glad to see you well.
rows.quest:6845:completion:1: BI received notice you would be coming in from the field, and I wanted to personally express the Cenarion Circle's gratitude for the assistance you've given us thus far. No doubt there are more secrets to uncover from ⟦E1⟧; your delivery to Umber should prove most interesting once uncovered. Please, accept this as a token of our continued appreciation for your aid.
rows.quest:8735:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to the four Emerald Dream portals in ⟦E7⟧ and collect a Fragment of the Nightmare's ⟦E8⟧ from each. Return to Keeper Remulos in the ⟦E4⟧ when you have completed this task.⟦8⟧
rows.quest:8735:details:0: You must travel to the four dream portals of ⟦E7⟧. From each you must draw a fragment of the Nightmare's corruption. The dragonkin that inhabit these areas will hold such fragments. Return to me when you have gathered these fragments.
rows.quest:8735:completion:0: Are you prepared? Is the world prepared for what we are about to invoke? I do not know... I am bound by duty to Malfurion. Duty and honor...
rows.quest:8736:obj:0: Defend Nighthaven from Eranikus. Do not let Keeper Remulos perish. Do not slay Eranikus. Defend yourself. Await Tyrande.⟦9⟧
rows.quest:8736:details:0: We must use restraint against Eranikus. We are to redeem him not destroy him.
rows.quest:8736:details:1: BTyrande is already en route to assist us in this task. We must weather the dragon's blows and save Nighthaven from certain destruction.
rows.quest:8736:details:2: BBe on guard! You and your allies are our only hope.⟦10⟧
rows.quest:8736:completion:0: He is redeemed, ⟦11⟧. He now returns to the Dream to right what he alone has done wrong. Eranikus will be a powerful ally to Malfurion and my father.
rows.quest:8736:completion:1: BThese armaments are for you, ⟦12⟧; given to me by ⟦E9⟧ herself. You would do well to make use of them in your battles against the Qiraji.
rows.quest:8741:obj:0: Take the Green Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in ⟦E10⟧.⟦13⟧
rows.quest:8741:details:0: The keeper awaits your return, ⟦14⟧. Take the green scepter shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.⟦15⟧
rows.quest:8741:completion:0: Your deeds will be known to all, champion. They will sing your praises from ⟦E11⟧ to the far reaches of the South Seas. All will know of the champion of the Bronze Flight, ⟦16⟧.
